{{Quote|Spaceport's in burning little chunks.|Shanra Immel, to Colonel Jace Malcom|<ref name="TLBoCJM" />}}
'''Kalandis Seven''' was a desolate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kalandis system/Legends|Kalandis system]], located in the [[Pallis sector/Legends|Pallis sector]] within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. In [[3640 BBY]], Kalandis Seven was [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|invaded]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sometime after the [[Battle of Corellia]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military forces]] on the surface struggled to keep a foothold while the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic]] and [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navies]] [[Space warfare/Legends|fought]] above the planet. During the battle, a Republic [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] on the planet's surface, including [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]], was chosen to destroy the [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local spaceport]]. The [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] mission was ultimately successful.

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Kalandis Seven was an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] world<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> located in the [[Kalandis system/Legends|Kalandis system]],<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> within the [[Pallis sector/Legends|Pallis sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Kalandis Seven was a harsh world that did not have any surface [[Water/Legends|water]] of its own. Its terrain was made up of canyons, cliffs, and cracked plains. The planet featured an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that was breathable by [[Human/Legends|Humans]], waterless fog, and low [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==History==
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}} "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" takes place between the [[Battle of Corellia]] and the events of ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'', both of which occur in [[3640 BBY]]; thus, the story must also occur in 3640 BBY.</ref> during the [[Galactic War]], the renewed conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Kalandis Seven was [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|invaded and occupied]] by the Sith Empire. Sometime after the Imperials [[Battle of Corellia|withdrew]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic's military forces]] on the planet's surface struggled to keep a foothold as the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] engaged the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial armada]] for control of the planet. [[Republic trooper|Republic]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] was given a mission to destroy the [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local spaceport]], with [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] assigned as an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to her [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. During the mission, a Sith [[Command ship/Legends|planetary command ship]] landed, and Malcom amended the mission to include the ship's capture. He alone went to capture the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], while Immel's squad went to destroy the spaceport. In the end, the command ship [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destructed]], and the mission to destroy the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was successful.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Locations==
Kalandis Seven was host to a few Republic and Imperial military bases and housed its own local [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Kalandis Seven was first mentioned as a desolate alien world within ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', a reference book released on [[October 2]], [[2012]]. Kalandis Seven first appeared and was first identified by name within the pages of [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story, ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'', which was released on [[October 23]], 2012 as part of [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]].
